Package com.cf.karaiskou.eshop.repository

Interface WishlistRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Wishlist,Long>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Wishlist,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Wishlist,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Wishlist,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Wishlist,Long>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Wishlist>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Wishlist,Long>
public interface WishlistRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Wishlist,Long>
Repository interface for managing Wishlist entities. Provides methods for:
  • Retrieving wishlist entries for a specific user
  • Checking if a product is already in a user's wishlist
  • Adding and removing wishlist entries
